---
title: "PDFをPNGに変換する"
---

ブラウザ上で完結するPDF→PNG変換ツール．ファイルはサーバーに送信されず，すべて端末内の処理のみで変換される．[pdf.js](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/)を利用．

```{=html}
<div class="pdf2png-tool">
  <div id="p2p-drop">
    <div class="p2p-main">ここにPDFをドロップ、またはクリックして選択</div>
    <div class="p2p-sub">1つのPDFファイルに対応</div>
    <input type="file" id="p2p-fileInput" accept="application/pdf">
  </div>

  <div class="p2p-controls">
    <label>解像度
      <select id="p2p-scale">
        <option value="1">1x</option>
        <option value="2" selected>2x</option>
        <option value="3">3x</option>
      </select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <div id="p2p-status"></div>
  <div id="p2p-pages"></div>
  <button class="p2p-primary" id="p2p-zipBtn">全ページをZIPでダウンロード</button>
</div>

<style>
  .pdf2png-tool{ margin: 1.5em 0; }
  #p2p-drop{
    border: 1px dashed #ced4da;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 32px 16px;
    text-align: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: #f8f9fa;
    transition: border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease;
  }
  #p2p-drop.hover{ border-color: #2761e3; background: #eef3fd; }
  #p2p-drop .p2p-sub{ font-size: 0.85em; color: #6c757d; margin-top: 4px; }
  .pdf2png-tool input[type=file]{ display:none; }
  .p2p-controls{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    margin-top: 14px; font-size: 0.9em; color: #6c757d;
  }
  .pdf2png-tool select{
    border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 6px;
  }
  #p2p-status{ font-size: 0.85em; color: #6c757d; margin-top: 12px; min-height: 16px; }
  #p2p-pages{
    margin-top: 18px; display:grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(120px, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .p2p-page-item{
    border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: 6px; overflow:hidden; text-align:center;
  }
  .p2p-page-item img{ width:100%; display:block; border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6; }
  .p2p-page-item .p2p-label{ font-size: 0.75em; color: #6c757d; padding: 5px 4px 2px; }
  .p2p-page-item a{ display:block; font-size: 0.75em; padding: 2px 0 6px; text-decoration:none; }
  button.p2p-primary{
    margin-top: 16px; background:#fff; color:#2761e3;
    border: 1px solid #2761e3; border-radius: 4px; padding: 7px 14px;
    font-size: 0.85em; cursor:pointer; display:none;
  }
  button.p2p-primary:hover{ background:#2761e3; color:#fff; }
</style>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function(){
  pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc =
    "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/pdf.worker.min.js";

  const drop = document.getElementById('p2p-drop');
  const fileInput = document.getElementById('p2p-fileInput');
  const status = document.getElementById('p2p-status');
  const pagesEl = document.getElementById('p2p-pages');
  const zipBtn = document.getElementById('p2p-zipBtn');
  const scaleSelect = document.getElementById('p2p-scale');

  let lastBlobs = [];

  drop.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click());
  drop.addEventListener('dragover', e => { e.preventDefault(); drop.classList.add('hover'); });
  drop.addEventListener('dragleave', () => drop.classList.remove('hover'));
  drop.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    drop.classList.remove('hover');
    if (e.dataTransfer.files.length) handleFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
  });
  fileInput.addEventListener('change', e => {
    if (e.target.files.length) handleFile(e.target.files[0]);
  });

  async function handleFile(file){
    if (file.type !== 'application/pdf'){
      status.textContent = 'PDFファイルを選択してください。';
      return;
    }
    pagesEl.innerHTML = '';
    zipBtn.style.display = 'none';
    lastBlobs = [];
    status.textContent = '読み込み中...';

    const scale = parseFloat(scaleSelect.value);
    const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const pdf = await pdfjsLib.getDocument({ data: arrayBuffer }).promise;
    const baseName = file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, '');

    for (let i = 1; i <= pdf.numPages; i++){
      status.textContent = `変換中... (${i}/${pdf.numPages})`;
      const page = await pdf.getPage(i);
      const viewport = page.getViewport({ scale });
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = viewport.width;
      canvas.height = viewport.height;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      await page.render({ canvasContext: ctx, viewport }).promise;

      const blob = await new Promise(res => canvas.toBlob(res, 'image/png'));
      const name = `${baseName}_p${String(i).padStart(2,'0')}.png`;
      lastBlobs.push({ name, blob });

      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const item = document.createElement('div');
      item.className = 'p2p-page-item';
      item.innerHTML = `
        <img src="${url}" alt="page ${i}">
        <div class="p2p-label">Page ${i}</div>
        <a href="${url}" download="${name}">ダウンロード</a>
      `;
      pagesEl.appendChild(item);
    }

    status.textContent = `完了: 全${pdf.numPages}ページを変換しました。`;
    if (pdf.numPages > 1) zipBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
  }

  zipBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    status.textContent = 'ZIPを作成中...';
    const zip = new JSZip();
    lastBlobs.forEach(({name, blob}) => zip.file(name, blob));
    const content = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(content);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = 'pdf2png_pages.zip';
    a.click();
    status.textContent = 'ZIPをダウンロードしました。';
  });
})();
</script>
```

::: {.callout-note}
このページの変換処理はすべてブラウザ内で完結しており，PDFの内容が外部サーバーに送信されることはない．
:::
